|errata_history=Versions of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 1, slip 14 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Obi-Wan’s game text may not be canceled and he may not be targeted by cards that capture. Regardless of Objective restrictions, Obi-Wan may Force drain where no other Jedi are present. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).” Stats line: “POWER 5 ABILITY 6 JEDI KNIGHT”. Deploy 5, forfeit 9. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•14” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 14), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Obi-Wan’s game text may not be canceled and he may not be targeted by cards that capture. Unless another Jedi present, may Force drain here regardless of Objective restrictions. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
